name: @tommy4st/mark-area
description: A lightweight CodeMirror 6 markdown editor custom element with live preview and form association

scripts.build:bundle: bun run build:lib && bun run build:standalone
scripts.build:types: bunx tsc index.ts define.ts tables.ts src/table/inline.ts src/table/preview.ts src/table/wysiwyg.ts --ignoreConfig --allowImportingTsExtensions --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --target ESNext --module preserve --moduleResolution bundler --lib ESNext,DOM
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:bundle && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.build:lib: bun build index.ts define.ts tables.ts src/table/inline.ts src/table/preview.ts src/table/wysiwyg.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external --splitting --minify
